product.name: Lians
product.summary: Lians gives AI agents durable memory across chats, sessions, tools, and models. It runs locally by default, connects through MCP or SDKs, and lets an agent remember useful facts and recall relevant current context without locking that memory to one model provider.

workflow.label: Remember
workflow.detail: Store one useful fact, preference, constraint, or decision that should survive the current chat.

workflow.label: Recall
workflow.detail: Retrieve a small, relevant set of current memories when a later task needs them.

workflow.label: Continue
workflow.detail: Point another compatible agent or model at the same memory store and continue with the same context.

workflow.label: Control
workflow.detail: Supersede stale facts, inspect where a memory came from, and use confirmed erasure where the integration exposes it.

surfaces.label: Lians Easy desktop installer
surfaces.detail: Guided, dependency-free local setup for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Codex, and Cline CLI, with cross-client memory and managed deployment flags.

surfaces.label: MCP memory server
surfaces.detail: Local memory for MCP-compatible agents with remember, recall, inspect, correct, and confirmed forget.

surfaces.label: Python local library
surfaces.detail: SQLite-backed memory inside Python applications with no server, Docker container, or API key.

surfaces.label: Pydantic AI integration
surfaces.detail: A tested local example that exposes current and point-in-time Lians recall as ordinary Pydantic AI function tools.

surfaces.label: LangGraph integration
surfaces.detail: A tested credential-free graph that remembers a fact locally and recalls it in a later invocation.

surfaces.label: Language SDKs
surfaces.detail: Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and C clients for connecting applications to a Lians service.

surfaces.label: Self-hosted service
surfaces.detail: A shared deployment path for teams that need server-backed memory, administration, and advanced controls.
